products.title: Prism Rivière Bracelet
products.descriptionHtml:
Colour, laid out in a straight line. This 18cm bracelet runs a continuous row of cushion cut pastel cubic zirconia of about 5mm, each stone framed by a fine halo of tiny clear pave, with the shades repeating through aqua blue, soft pink and pale yellow. The metal is PVD rhodium coated and a fold over clasp keeps the line flat on the wrist. Wear it when you want colour without anything loud.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with a white tee and cool toned rings for an easy summer wrist.

Details

  • Length: 18cm
  • Stone: Cushion cut pastel cubic zirconia, approximately 5mm each
  • Setting: Each stone framed by a fine pave halo, linked in a continuous line
  • Colour: Aqua blue, soft pink and pale yellow in repeating order
  • Closure: Fold over clasp
  • Plating: PVD rhodium coating, anti-tarnish
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

products.title: Bougainvillea Vine Bracelet
products.descriptionHtml:
A vine in bloom, around the wrist. A slender silver tone vine of curving stems and small pavé leaves, with five flowers along it: two small five petal flowers on each side and one larger six petal flower of about 11mm at the centre, each with a tiny clear cubic zirconia at its heart. In Fuchsia, with a deep ruby red centre flower, or Violet, with a soft lilac centre flower. It closes with a fold over clasp. Wear it to a garden lunch or a sangeet.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone with a sleeveless blouse so the whole vine shows.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Flowers: Four small five petal flowers, approximately 7mm, and one six petal centre flower, approximately 11mm
  • Stones: Coloured cubic zirconia petals, clear cubic zirconia centres, joints and pavé leaves
  • Colours: Fuchsia with a ruby red centre flower, or Violet with a lilac centre flower
  • Closure: Fold over clasp
  • Finish: Bright silver tone
  • Plating: PVD rhodium coating, anti-tarnish
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

products.title: Clover Drop Earrings
products.descriptionHtml:
Two clovers, one swinging below the other. On each earring a four petal clover of round clear cubic zirconia sits on the lobe, and a second, smaller clover hangs below it on a tiny gold jump ring. About 19mm long, they fall just past the lobe and catch the light as they move.

STYLING TIP: Wear them with the Clover Drop Pendant Necklace for the full set.

Details

  • Clovers: Approximately 8.5mm at the lobe and 6.5mm below
  • Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia, four to each clover, around a polished gold bead
  • Setting: Fine gold claws

  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

products.title: Molten Wave Ear Cuff
products.descriptionHtml:

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the Molten Bloom Hoops on the same ear.

Details

  • Size: Approximately 15mm across and 12mm tall
  • Style: Ear cuff, no piercing needed
  • Form: Five wavy molten loops side by side
  • Fit: Slides onto the middle of the ear
  • Sold as: A single cuff
  • Stones: None
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • Material: Stainless steel
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

products.title: Clover Drop Pendant Necklace
products.descriptionHtml:
One clover, and a smaller one below. A fine gold tone cable chain holds a four petal clover of round clear cubic zirconia set around a small polished gold bead, and from it a second, smaller clover swings on a tiny jump ring. The upper clover is about 8.5mm across and the whole drop about 17mm, so it sits light at the base of the throat and moves when you do.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the Clover Drop Earrings for the matching set.

Details

  • Drop: Approximately 17mm long

  • Centre: A small polished gold bead in each clover
  • Setting: Fine gold claws
  • Chain: Fine cable chain
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

The bow is about 10mm wide and the whole pendant about 15mm tall, on a fine gold tone cable chain.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone at the base of the throat, with a shirt open at the collar.

Details
